task: Add end-to-end tests for the notes page (`/`). Acceptance criteria: (1) adding a title creates a note in the list; (2) notes are listed alphabetically by title, ignoring letter case; (3) Edit turns a note's title into a text field, and Save applies the new title to that note; (4) Delete removes exactly the chosen note; (5) additions, edits and deletions are stored on the server, so a reload shows the same list; (6) the counter under the heading reads `1 note` or `N notes`. The test seam `POST /api/reset` deletes every note.

faults.description: Adding a note changes nothing on the page until a reload.
Save shows the new title but the server keeps the old one; a reload shows the old title.
Delete removes the note from the page only; a reload brings it back.
Delete removes the alphabetically first note from the page instead of the chosen one (the server deletes the right one).
